items.caption: 笑死
items.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL expressive Chinese chat sticker animation sprite sheet, EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS,12 equal square cells, canvas1440x1080. SIMPLE bold handdrawn black contours, flat few colors, NO detailed fur/pencil shading, not realistic illustration. Strong readable facial acting and clear gestures at240px. Same ORIGINAL animal in all cells, not any known character. OPAQUE WHITE background, thin lightgray grid, NO text/symbols/captions/watermarks. Every figure fully contained in upper80% of its cell, bottom20% blank white for caption. Fixed camera/scale, no cropping, same body/head anchor except intentional SMALL squash/stretch. Sequence left-right top-bottom:1 anticipation;2-7 progressively build action in distinct smooth poses;8 expressive peak;9-11 clearly ease back;12 precisely matches1 for seamless loop. Face and body move together meaningfully; do not merely slide a static drawing. No extra limbs, no hand switches, no props. Original FAT ORANGE CAT with small triangle ears, huge soft cheek pads, tiny brow marks, stubby paws, dark orange forehead patch and cream belly. COMEDIC hearty laughter: start broad grin/eyes smiling, paws near belly; gradually eyes squeeze shut, mouth opens huge into laughing bean shape, cheeks lift, BOTH paws clutch belly, body gently squashes at peak8 as laughing hard.9-12 mouth slowly closes, eyes easeopen and belly posture returns. Exaggerate mouth/eyelids/cheeks and paw positions markedly, maintain recognizable head proportions. Fun expressive drawing not cute frozen mascot.
